# Anatomy build helpers

Copied from the locally installed Anatomy skill, 26 October 2026. Original source: https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy, copyright Ryan, MIT. The accompanying LICENSE is retained. These modules generate and audit SVG at build time; none is served as a browser runtime. The portfolio supplies its own token-based styles, HTML controls, and state model. No publishing, capture, browser automation, or remote gallery scripts are included.
